title: Finish Window Tools to Utilities Rename
description: Complete the in-progress rename of the per-window "tools" palette concept to "utilities" across the whole stack. Approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/window-tools-should-be-reactive-raccoon.md: shrink window_utility -> utility, rename category literal "tools" -> "utilities" (Rust UtilityCategory::Utilities), rename generic Toolbar* primitives -> Ribbon* family (GlassTier::Toolbar -> Ribbon too), rename transformTool -> transformMode wire key across React + all plugin crates + infinite/world, rename window utility-bar chrome (WindowToolbarChrome -> UtilityBarChrome, Window.toolbar prop -> utilityBar), rename ui.toolbar.* i18n/id namespace -> ui.ribbon.*/ui.utilities.*, rename renderer ribbon-building functions (buildToolbarRibbonSegments -> buildUtilityRibbonSegments, derive_toolbar_nodes -> derive_utility_nodes), rename panel label keys ui.panel.tools/toolsHistory -> ui.panel.actions/history, delete dead activeTool document field + fixture key, rename lowpoly labels.tool -> labels.utility, and sweep remaining fixture/demo/prose legacy naming. English copy becomes "Utilities"; German keeps natural terms (Werkzeuge/Werkzeugparameter/Werkzeugleiste). ARIA role="toolbar" and unrelated tool concepts (tooltips, CNC cutting tools, BRep boolean tool_ids, build tooling) stay untouched.
summary:
Completed the window-tools→utilities rename end-to-end. Rust: UtilityCategory::Tools→Utilities (wire "utilities"), GlassTier::Toolbar→Ribbon, transformTool→transformMode wire key across all emitting/consuming plugins, render_window_utility_options_rail→render_utility_options_rail, derive_toolbar_nodes→derive_utility_nodes, active_toolbar_window_kind→active_utility_bar_window_kind, deleted dead DocumentJson.active_tool field + activeTool fixture/map.remove, lowpoly labels.tool→labels.utility (en "Utility", de kept "Werkzeug"), plus a full prose/comment/assertion-string sweep ("toolbar"→"utility bar"/"ribbon" as appropriate) across ~20 plugin crates. TS: WindowToolbarChrome→UtilityBarChrome, Window.toolbar/toolbarFolded/onToolbarFoldedChange props→utilityBar/utilityBarFolded/onUtilityBarFoldedChange, generic ToolbarZone/Group/Item/Divider primitives→RibbonZone/Group/Item/Divider, GlassTier "toolbar" tier→"ribbon" (+glassToolbarClass→glassRibbonClass, floatingToolbarSurfaceClass→floatingRibbonSurfaceClass), ui.toolbar.* i18n/id namespace→ui.ribbon.*/ui.utilities.* (UiToolbarParentCategory→UiRibbonParentCategory, DOM tree ids), buildToolbarRibbonSegments→buildUtilityRibbonSegments (+ types), ui.panel.tools/toolsHistory label keys→actions/history, renamed Toolbar.stories.tsx→Ribbon.stories.tsx. English copy now says "Utilities"; German kept natural terms (Werkzeuge/Werkzeugparameter). Fixed the one cross-technology compile/behavior break this caused in compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts (renamed type import, updated its ui.toolbar.*→ui.ribbon.* id-prefix resolver) without touching compose's own internal naming, per the "don't mix technologies" rule. transformTool (gumball move/rotate/scale mode, a separate concept from window utilities) renamed to transformMode per user decision. ARIA role="toolbar" and unrelated tool concepts (tooltips, CNC cutting-tool geometry, BRep boolean tool_ids, build tooling, Storybook's own toolbar addon) left untouched.

Verification: repo-wide grep gates for every legacy pattern (window_utility/WindowUtility, UtilityCategory::Tools, transformTool/transform_tool, activeTool, remaining Toolbar identifiers) all pass clean except compose's own internal namespace and Storybook's native toolbar addon (both correctly out of scope). Ran framework-renderer-react's vitest suite directly (bypassing a severely congested shared nx/cargo environment — 60+ concurrent cargo builds from other sessions drove load average to 12-18 and stalled every nx-orchestrated and cargo test/check invocation for hours on shared target-dir/registry locks): 182/182 tests passed cleanly. The ui/js/react self-test suite and full cargo test/check for the touched Rust crates could not complete in this session due to that environment contention (not a code issue — the isolated, most-heavily-changed suite passed); recommend re-running `bun ./📜️script.ts test` in ui/js/react and `cargo test -p ui_wgpu -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu -p semio-framework-plugin -p framework_surface_paint -p raster-plugin -p puzzle-plugin -p note-plugin -p lowpoly-plugin -p cad-plugin -p procedural-plugin -p shooting-plugin -p process-plugin -p infinite_world -p draw-plugin -p forms-plugin -p sequence-plugin -p trinity-plugin -p writer-plugin -p s-plugin` once the shared environment quiets down.
